summary: Iter82 re-verification (backend only). The 3 previously-failing assertions now PASS: (a) TestMongo::test_all_linked_b2b_skus_renamed, (b) TestSupabaseMirror::test_no_stale_bilvapatra_name_in_mirror, (c) TestSupabaseMirror::test_no_orphan_b2b_mirror_rows. All requested sanity checks pass: products_mirror WHERE name ILIKE '%Bilvapatra%' -> 0 rows; products_mirror WHERE id LIKE 'mogra%' -> 0 rows; Mongo b2b_products WHERE product_id='bilvapatra-fragrance' -> belpatra-dhoop-b2b='Belpatra Dhoop', bilvapatra-fragrance-50g-b2b='Belpatra' (both mirrored with same names). Iter80 DELETE cascade + no-orphan and iter81 per-entity FIFO lock regressions PASS. HOWEVER the Iter82 fix introduced a NEW regression: the B2C Supabase mirror row for 'bilvapatra-fragrance' now has stock_pieces = NULL (was 0 before the fix), breaking the iter79/80 invariant 'all active b2c mirror rows have non-null price_inr + stock_pieces'. Fails in BOTH suites (test_iter82_product_cleanup::test_regression_price_and_stock_hydrated and test_iter80_cascade_delete::test_active_b2c_rows_have_price_and_stock), reproduced 4/4 runs and again immediately after a backend restart.

critical.endpoint: routers/products.py::_migrate_products (Iter82 block, step 2 'Re-mirror B2C row') -> Supabase products_mirror
critical.issue: Regression: mirror row 'bilvapatra-fragrance' (channel='b2c') now has stock_pieces = NULL. The migration calls services.supabase_sync.mirror_product_upsert(b2c_doc, channel='b2c') with the RAW Mongo product doc. supabase_sync._product_row derives b2c stock from sizes[].stock (set only by the B2B stock enricher at serve time); the raw doc's sizes = [{'size':'50g','mrp':110,'price':110,'images':[...]}] has no 'stock' key and no top-level stock_pieces, so stock=None is written and it OVERWRITES the previously hydrated value (0). Fix: hydrate the doc before mirroring (reuse the same enricher used by GET /api/products, e.g. sum b2b_products.stock_pieces per net_weight into sizes[].stock, or set doc['stock_pieces']) OR skip the b2c stock column on partial re-mirrors instead of nulling it. Reproduced persistently, including immediately after `supervisorctl restart backend` (migration re-runs unconditionally each boot).

minor.issue: Migration still runs on EVERY startup and swallows exceptions with logger.warning; the b2c re-mirror is unconditional so it re-nulls stock on each boot. No migrations-completed marker (repeat of iter82 review comment).

rca_of_the_issue: Iter82 fix correctly propagates the rename to derived B2B SKUs via mirror_b2c_product (which re-mirrors only the b2b rows) and then unconditionally calls mirror_product_upsert(b2c_doc, channel='b2c') with the raw Mongo doc. _product_row computes b2c stock_pieces from doc['stock_pieces'] or sum(sizes[].stock); neither exists on the stored doc (stock lives in b2b_products.stock_pieces and is injected only by the read-path enricher), so the upsert writes stock_pieces=NULL over the previously hydrated 0. Repro: supervisorctl restart backend; sleep 20; SELECT stock_pieces FROM products_mirror WHERE id='bilvapatra-fragrance' -> NULL. Mitigation: enrich sizes[].stock from b2b_products before mirroring, or make the b2c upsert preserve stock when the source value is None.
